semantic_contract.required_behavior: Select a qualitative conversational initiative level from exact current context while preserving explicit requests, required alerts, Not Now deferral, stale-context failure and structural separation from collaboration depth and action authority.
non_negotiable_semantics: Presence levels are exactly QUIET, NUDGE, COLLABORATE and LEAD
old or policy-less contexts default deterministically to ephemeral QUIET
relevance is explained qualitatively rather than by fabricated numeric confidence or relevance scores
NO_ACTION or leave-it-alone is a first-class truthful result
current explicit Artist requests and required safety, contradiction, stale-context and rights/privacy alerts survive QUIET and prior Not Now deferral
Not Now remains authoritative for unsolicited interventions
decisions bind to exact Artist, Song, Session, Focus and job context and fail closed when context moves
unknown future policy versions and malformed semantic input fail safely
Presence policy remains ephemeral and is not persisted by this kernel
action authority granted, mutation authorized and external action authorized remain structurally hard-false
Presence remains distinct from collaboration depth and ASK/ADVISE/TRY/DO action authority
interpretations_required: reconcile Presence with repaired Creative Partner lenses/relevance and REQ-SCOPE-157 InteractionPolicy without collapsing these separate policy dimensions
remaining_semantics: consumer reachability through NOW, Song, Produce and Learn
